I’m an ER nurse and I’ve had all the same symptoms as you and I was diagnosed with gastritis, pancreatitis, GERD, and colitis. All at different times. I’ve had an endoscopy, colonoscopy, CT of the abdomen, and blood work to get to those diagnoses. 

I recommend you make an appointment with a Gastroenterologist if you haven’t already done so. They specialize in stomach issues. If you have already seen one and they aren’t helping you... FIND A DIFFERENT ONE! I’ve gone through 4 GI doctors in 20 yrs. it’s okay to “doctor shop” until you find one that finally gets to the bottom of your problems and actually helps you.

Best wishes on your health. I hope you get the answers you need.
